safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Stating “No vitals recorded” is an unsupported documentation claim in this remote headache consult; the transcript does not explicitly confirm whether vitals were or were not obtained outside the call. While unlikely to directly injure the patient, inaccurate vitals documentation can reduce clinical situational awareness (e.g., overlooking the need to check blood pressure in a new severe headache) and may lead to additional follow-up or rework.
